# PureVedicGems

> Certified natural Vedic gemstones, Rudraksha, and custom jewelry from a heritage brand established in 1937. Expert astrological guidance, lab certification, and worldwide insured delivery.

Pure Vedic Gems (PURE VEDIC GEMS PVT. LTD.) sells Navaratna and Upratna gemstones, Rudraksha, jewelry, malas, and idols for Jyotish and spiritual use. Primary market: India; ships worldwide.

Contact: purevedicgems@gmail.com | +91-9871582404

## Shop

- [Gemstones](https://www.purevedicgems.com/gemstones): Navaratna, Upratna, and gemstone collections
- [Navaratna gems](https://www.purevedicgems.com/gemstones/navaratna): Nine primary Vedic gemstones (Ruby, Pearl, Coral, Emerald, Yellow Sapphire, Diamond, Blue Sapphire, Hessonite, Cat's Eye)
- [Upratna gems](https://www.purevedicgems.com/gemstones/upratna): Substitute gemstones for planetary remedies
- [Rudraksha](https://www.purevedicgems.com/rudraksha): Authentic Mukhi Rudraksha beads and collections
- [Jewelry & designs](https://www.purevedicgems.com/designs): Custom ring, pendant, bracelet, and Rudraksha settings
